item.title: Meet Kevin — Inside the Unprecedented SEC Bailout of Stocks & Crypto | Major Rule Change
item.description:
Point: SEC innovation exemption lets 1:1 tokenized stocks trade on-chain for 5 years without exchange registration or best-execution — framed as a bailout after Clarity Act failed.

Published 2026-09-18 · Age at process 22h · 27:19 · Watch: Skim

  • On-chain stock tokens, no exchange registration, no best bid/offer
  • Timing: ~2 days after Clarity Act failed
  • Benefits crypto rails and brokers (Robinhood called out)
  • Disclosure looser in a test window, not a full statute

Skip the first ~5 minutes of framing; the rule itself is the payload.
